name: Manfred Huber
title: Professor; Co-director of DASC Program
fitReason: Strong methods fit through visual RL, learned task-relevant representations and world-model control, with a collaborative actual manipulation deployment.

physicalEvidence.summary: DeGuV (September 2025), coauthored with Manchester and UTA researchers, executes a trained depth-mask visual RL policy on a real Franka Emika Lift task using ROS2, panda-py and Intel D435i RGB-D input. The policy outputs end-effector increments and gripper commands. The paper does not clearly establish UTA as the physical test site, and its real-robot section is a qualitative transfer demonstration rather than the four-task simulation benchmark. Physical score is capped at 20 for collaborative-site evidence. The separate July 2025 Huber/Dang neural-local-frame mapping paper describes in-lab navigation; it is not used to assert a particular named current robot platform.

shortVisit.summary: Current UTA directory and faculty homepage establish appointment and robot-learning interests, but no explicit external-master short-visitor invitation was located. Old personal CV and course listing are not an opening.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct substantive visual RL and task-centric learned world models.
scoreReasons.physical: Actual joint Franka policy execution verified; test-site ownership and present UTA availability unresolved, so cap 20.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No applicable external visitor invitation. Institutional route is not a lab offer.
scoreReasons.freshness: August 2026 TaskSense preprint and current official appointment; its DMC benchmarks are simulation, distinct from 2025 hardware.
